clean_repro.probe: POST /entities/search on collection 'test_unloaded_review' (created without explicit load call) with vector [[0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]]
clean_repro.observed: Search succeeded with HTTP 200, returning result {distance: 1, id: 1}. Collection load_state shows LoadStateLoaded=100% despite never calling load().

violated_assumptions: Original defect claim assumes search should fail on unloaded collections (dependency on explicit load requirement)
Assumes get_load_state must return 'NotLoaded' for collections without explicit load call

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_state_entities_search_001 - 'Collection must be loaded; index must exist on annsField'
contract_id: milvus_behavioral_entities_search_001 - 'Search returns 400 on dimension mismatch or invalid params'

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 handler.search() → proxy.Search() → (no explicit load verification observed in HTTP layer)
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:REST v2 search handler 不做显式 load 状态检查,直接透传到 proxy 层。存在 ignoreGrowing 参数支持(默认 false)允许查询 growing segments。这是 by-design 行为:Milvus 支持对'未显式加载'的集合做搜索(数据可在 growing segments 中查到)。

falsification.probe: Verify via get_load_state that collection is considered loaded despite no explicit load() call
falsification.observed: get_load_state returns LoadStateLoaded with loadProgress=100%, confirming Milvus treats the collection as queryable without explicit load

excluded: 请求参数错误(参数完整有效)
环境问题(Docker 容器正常运行)
并发/竞态条件(单线程操作)

cognition_match.note: 未命中明确 by_design_patterns,但源码显示 Milvus 2.6.17 支持'自动加载/隐式加载'语义:growing segments 可被搜索,ignoreGrowing=false(默认)时包含未密封段

verdicts.rationale: Milvus 2.6.17 REST v2 API 允许对未显式调用 load() 的集合执行搜索操作。源码显示 search handler 不验证 load 状态,直接转发请求,且支持 ignoreGrowing 参数(默认 false)包含 growing segments。实测 get_load_state 返回 LoadStateLoaded=100%,表明系统内部自动处理了查询所需的内存加载。这是 by-design 行为,非缺陷。原始 oracle 误将'隐式加载'能力解读为'未加载应失败'的约束违反。
